items.t: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. Announces Total Crypto and Total Cash & Marketable Securities Holdings of $11.8 Billion
Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
items.sum: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

items.t: Tom Lee Points to Anthropic IPO as Ether Slide Cuts Bitmine’s Holdings to $11.8 Billion
items.sum: Bitmine added 7,653 ETH last week, and its chairman compared ether’s 28% two-week drop to the sell-off before SpaceX went public.
